Problem Title: Data Interoperability Failure in Rural Clinics
Description: Rural healthcare providers lack a unified system to access patient records across different local specialists, causing delayed treatments and duplicate lab tests.
Who Faces It: Rural clinic administrators, primary care physicians, regional specialists, and ER triage teams.

Why Frustrating: Staff must spend hours manually tracking down, printing, and scanning faxed documents, which frequently contain unreadable handwriting or missing pages.
Current Solution: Legacy thermal fax machines, paper courier delivery, and phone calls between medical records clerks.

Problem Title: Cold Chain Temperature Excursions in Biologic Cargo
Description: Temperature-controlled pharmaceutical shipments experience unmonitored thermal spikes during intermodal airport tarmac handoffs, spoiling $35B in critical medicine annually without real-time alerts.

Current Solution: Passive dry ice blankets, USB flash-drive temperature dataloggers read upon arrival, and manual clipboard check sheets.
